legend-salkammergut-lakes-road.slogan: Salkammergut Lakes Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-salkammergut-lakes-road.story: curated scenic road. lakes, limestone Alps, historic villages. From Salzburg it runs 73 km to Gosau; allow about 1 h 20 of riding. On the way it passes Fuschl am See, Sankt Gilgen and Bad Ischl. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Salkammergut Lakes Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 12 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
